title: Pattern preservation in finite to infinite-horizon optimal control problems for dissipative systems
summary: This paper focuses on infinite-horizon optimal control problems for dissipative systems and the relations to their finite-horizon formulations. We show that, for a large class of problems, dissipativity of the state equation, when a coercive storage function exists, implies that infinite-horizon optimal controls can be obtained as limits of the corresponding finite-horizon ones. This property is referred to as pattern preservation, or pattern-preserving property. Our analysis establishes a formal link between dissipativity theory and the variational convergence framework in optimal control,…
